newsArray.title: West Indies pinned to 23-1 by Pakistan in rain-affected start to first test
newsArray.description: TAROUBA, Trinidad (AP) — Mohammad Abbas’ impressive seam bowling pinned West Indies to 23-1 against Pakistan in a rain-affected start to the first test at Brian Lara Stadium on Saturday. Rain allowed only 14.1 overs in 74 minutes of play before lunch after West Indies captain Roston Chase won the toss and elected to bat.
